description: WRITE (gated): move ONE post to a new future slot (ISO 8601, at least 15 minutes out). Unlike cancel_post this also accepts FAILED posts: a failed post is re-queued (status -> scheduled, error cleared). Draft and scheduled posts keep their status. Refuses posts that would structurally fail again (archived brand, incompatible media, Facebook with no Page).

post_id.description: Post id (from list_posts, content_queue or diagnose_failures)

scheduled_date.description: New slot, ISO 8601, at least 15 minutes in the future

name: reschedule_post
